from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from one company's 10-Q filing for the quarter ended March 31, 2025."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name as stated in the filing")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="Period end date in YYYY-MM format")
    revenue: float | None = Field(description="Total revenues or net sales for the quarter")
    revenue_unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of revenue: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    long_term_debt: float | None = Field(description="Long-term debt as of period end")
    long_term_debt_unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of debt: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    total_equity: float | None = Field(description="Total Stockholders' Equity as of period end")
    equity_unit: str | None = Field(description="Scale of equity: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyFinancialData]
